interpretation: Additional diagnostic cannot replace original H2 acceptance matrix or its four-connection TCP regression.
Context switches are scheduler counters, not exact pacer wakeups.
Profile runs include server warmup and shutdown and are excluded from timing aggregation.
Simulator drops are exact local queue decisions; QUIC declared losses can be spurious and are not physical loss or retransmission counts.
H3 warmup differs from original H2; length and warmup/settling are not independently isolated. Additional H4 is separately planned, not included here.
One four-connection candidate run incurred5779us cgroup throttling, below0.03percent of its measurement wall; retain this fact rather than claiming zero throttling.
H1 phase is unavailable. A cwnd minimum alone cannot identify PROBE_RTT or loss recovery.
One-second H1 cumulative counters can have sample-boundary offset; actual received TCP bytes and simulator decisions are the primary exact measures.
